src: IP адреса — број који разуме рачунар
IPv4 адреса има четири октета од 0 до 255, одвојена тачкама.

dst: IP address — a number that the computer understands
Informatics and Computer Science · 7th grade · class 011
An IPv4 address has four octets from 0 to 255, separated by dots.
Four octets separated by dots — it is.

a document organized as a network of parts; clicking takes you from one place to another.
a clickable part of text or image that leads to a target: another part of the document, another document, or a site.
